answer.rationale: With the contract expiring in 14 days and the line at 94% of committed volume, a primary-source change or new-source qualification creates unacceptable delivery exposure. The incumbent has refused a price reopening, so this does not solve the 18% spend mandate; however, renewal is the only available one-decision path that preserves continuity while retaining the opportunity to address cost at the next review. Verify the incumbent continuity record before committing.
